description: A React component for a color input with a color picker, allowing users to input or select colors, with support for validation and focus management.

classes.name: ColorInput
classes.description: A React component for color input with color picker functionality.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes refs and state for the component.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Synchronizes state with props when value changes.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Adds or removes event listeners based on color picker open state.

methods.name: checkClick
methods.description: Handles click outside to close color picker.

methods.name: togglePicker
methods.description: Toggles the color picker open/close state.

methods.name: handleColorChange
methods.description: Handles color change from the color picker.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles manual input change, validates and normalizes color.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Handles focus event on input, selects text.

methods.name: onBlur
methods.description: Handles blur event, validates and updates color.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events to open color picker on Enter or Space.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the color input component with color box and picker.
